dedupe_keys.name: korea architecture hub building energy information open api 건물에너지정보 서비스

description: This open API from Korea's Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport gives monthly electricity and gas use of buildings collected by the national integrated building energy management system and served through the Architecture HUB. Each row is keyed by district code, legal dong code and lot numbers, with the month of use and electricity and gas use in kilowatt-hours, aggregated per land lot. Detached houses, apartment complexes of fewer than 200 households (from January 2020) and energy used for industry, transport, power generation, combined heat and power or electric vehicle charging are excluded. Coverage: South Korea. Access: free REST API on the public data portal with an API key, in JSON or XML. Licence: no restriction on use. Caveats: aggregated per lot, not per building or meter; small housing is excluded, so residential coverage is partial; the portal reset connections several times while reading. Simulation uses are monthly building energy baselines for calibration of stock models, heat and cold wave demand studies and retrofit targeting. Related records: the Architecture HUB building register API, which shares lot codes, and the Korea prototypical office energy policy case study.
